releases.title: Octave modifier chord keys and Backup Studio
notes: Assign O1 (+1), o1 (-1), o2 (-2) and O2 (+2) octave modifiers to any chord key in SEL.
Standalone USB-MIDI Backup & Restore Studio (flower_backup_app.py) with bundled MGMT - Kids preset.
Rebranded to CoralTulip 0.6.2 with native Windows and WSL USB-MIDI support.
